title: Gaurish Metha — media manifest
reviewNotes: Original files are preserved in PICS/; this manifest does not rename, alter, or move them.
Only images explicitly marked publishOnSite are used on the public-facing page.
Images were visually inspected. JPEG metadata was checked for GPS EXIF; none of the supplied images contained a GPS tag.
Browser screenshots, unrelated group photos, and redundant frames are retained locally but excluded; event photographs selected by Gaurish are explicitly approved for their matching archive entry.
Dates, placements, and project outcomes are only stated where supported by the supplied notes or visible evidence.
